contracts.title: Claude active/inactive credential ownership
resultContract: Entry forwards active and inactive calls. Pre-aborted active call returns error/null windows. Runtime WSL with missing Linux config fails before host credential reads. Supplied runtime preparation is consumed here; its materialization is separately assigned, not certified.

Credential JSON accepts a truthy string accessToken without trimming; refreshability requires a nonblank trimmed refreshToken. Active usage ignores expiresAt. Malformed or absent OAuth object returns no token. On macOS an explicit config uses strict scoped Keychain then legacy; scoped token wins, legacy token beats scoped refresh-only, then refresh-only candidates. Available Keychain token/refreshability suppresses file fallback. Otherwise reads configDir or home/.claude credentials file; read/parse failures yield empty credentials, retaining Keychain-unavailable metadata if applicable. These local reads have no byte/deadline/caller-abort bound.

Active stale scoped host-system token can retry one DIFFERENT legacy token; managed provenance and WSL exclude that fallback. Live managed terminal ownership defers refresh-only/stale repair. CLI repair invokes CLI, rereads credentials, retries OAuth even if token unchanged, and fills missing OAuth windows from CLI; a failed repair can reach another CLI fallback. No generic exponential provider retry. Attempted sources are ordered/deduplicated; optional metadata fields may exist as undefined before serialization.

Inactive managed account resolves ownership and reads credentials, returning missing-credentials error if absent. Expired/missing/nonfinite expiry with a refresh token invokes app-owned refresh (five-minute margin); refresh uses a separate ten-second HTTP signal without caller cancellation. Successful provider rotation may precede abort or failed local persistence. Write failure is swallowed and the refreshed token is still used. Usage fetch rejection can propagate to the accepted cycle.

Host managed path must canonicalize below app userData/claude-accounts with exactly accountId/auth, rejecting candidate symlink and invalid marker. adoptLegacyMarker can CREATE mode0600 exclusive marker while resolving; mismatched existing marker cannot be overwritten and yields null. Child reads reject symlink/nonfile/outside canonical directory. WSL ownership uses Windows UNC distro, expected managed suffix and nonsymlink matching marker; it does not establish the same full ancestor-realpath proof.

Managed file refresh writes mode0600 temp PID+UUID then rename, with six Windows permission/busy attempts and 50..250ms synchronous delays. First failure removes temp, optionally repairs parent ACL and retries once; cleanup can mask the original error, no fsync or atomic compare-to-old guard. Reuse E4 keychain and ACL contracts for their actual OS implementation.

Managed preview on macOS stages scoped active Keychain credentials at the managed path, captures replacement credentials and deletes the scoped item in finally; deletion failure ignored, no restoration of a preexisting scoped value. Windows returns no panel supplement. macOS panel trust needs at least one shared OAuth/CLI window and all shared percentages within one point; it does not compare reset time/account identity. Active supplements fill only missing windows and preserve primary status/error/time; inactive supplement requires explicit opt-in.

OAuth refresh accepts nonblank access token, keeps old refresh token unless new nonblank token, merges old fields, finite expires_in including negative into now+seconds, and splits scope on literal spaces. Missing OAuth object is not expiring; absent/nonfinite expiry is. Direct malformed-root merge may throw but the refresh wrapper catches and returns null. HTTP failures return null; raw network error messages can reach console.

Environment patch mutates its supplied map: optional stripping removes four named auth variables and custom headers matching authorization/x-api-key/api-key/bearer; nonblank config replaces configDir, explicitly defined custom-header patch (including empty) replaces header. It is not an exhaustive secret scrubber or launch-ownership proof.
futureAcceptance: Synthetic token/expiry scalar/null/whitespace matrix and exact credential precedence; no host read or legacy fallback for unresolved WSL/managed ownership.
Refresh rotation followed by caller abort, write/cleanup/ACL failure and competing write; distinguish provider success from durable local publication.
Preview preexisting scoped item, denied cleanup, mismatched resets but similar percentages, Windows omission; retain source behavior and separate intended restoration/security correction.
Assert active fallback request counts (429 zero CLI; stale legacy distinct; CLI repair+reread; repeated CLI on failed repair) and metadata own-property undefined versus JSON omission.

contracts.title: Claude OAuth HTTP schema, classification and retry metadata
resultContract: Electron net OAuth request awaits best-effort default-session proxy setup BEFORE its ten-second HTTP timeout, checks caller abort, sends bearer and fixed version/beta headers, and consumes response JSON without a root schema guard. No overall operation deadline follows from the HTTP timeout.

five_hour/seven_day use the unchanged root-reviewed window mapper (including its recorded NaN/reset limitations). Fable first searches limits for weekly_scoped with finite utilization and normalized display name Fable, ignoring is_active, then legacy Fable fields. Wrong display-name type/null response can throw. Successful response may return status ok with every usage window null.

429 yields fixed rate-limited text and optional retryAtMs: positive numeric seconds or future HTTP date, capped at 24 hours; zero/invalid/past => absent/undefined metadata. Non429 provider error.message is selected by truthy trimmed presence but original string retained. skipPtyFallback flag exists on the HTTP error; active decision is classification-driven.

401 and non-profile 403 classify stale-token; 403 containing case-sensitive user:profile is terminal missing-scope; 429 terminal rate-limited; >=500 CLI fallback server; other HTTP terminal usage-unavailable. SyntaxError is parse fallback, network/abort-pattern error is network fallback, unknown error also CLI fallback. Raw provider messages and several warning messages are not uniformly redacted.
futureAcceptance: Null/array/scalar response, utilization NaN/string, malformed limits/display_name, inactive Fable and legacy precedence; explicit all-null ok result.
429 numeric/date boundary plus 401/403 substring case, 500, invalid JSON, abort before/after proxy; assert request count and no inference of wall deadline from timeout construction.

contracts.title: Claude/Codex CLI text input and termination
resultContract: Host PTYs use tiny temp cwd, reject filesystem root after realpath, run resolved CLI through inherited/path-adjusted environment; WSL uses explicit login-shell config export and fixed temp cwd. Windows command quoting and WSL ownership are explicit. Executable/package resolution and node-pty import occur outside some probe timers; no platform execution performed.

Claude 120x40 PTY keeps last100000 characters, nudges /usage after two seconds and Enter every800ms, answers recognized trust prompt y (a possible CLI trust/config side effect), uses finite stop substrings and a two-second settling delay; Claude2.1 stats panel gets eight-second grace. Twenty-five-second timeout or exit can still yield ok when any window parses; no window yields error. No provider inference was launched in this audit.

Claude section labels bound percentage scan to12 lines and reset scan to14 until next section. Percent grammar consumes integer digits (fractional percentage is not preserved), used/consumed versus remaining orientation and clamp; one parsed window permits partial success. Reset parser accepts positive relative day/hour/minute sums, month/day with rollover and wall-clock zone validation, weekday/time with local rollover; timezone annotation is not used for weekday/time-only cases. Invalid reset => null timestamp while description remains provider text.

Codex PTY keeps last100000 characters; fifteen-second timeout, data/prompt-gated initial /status nudge, delayed Enter and retry, auth-error short-circuit, and500ms settle after quota. Exit may retain parsed partial success; timeout path is error. Parser takes first unscoped 5h/weekly label, excludes model-scoped adjacency through lookbehind, integer percent with explicit left inversion (otherwise used), clamps, canonical300/10080 windows, and shared reset parser. Wrong/missing labels give null windows.

PTY writes/disposer callbacks are not universally guarded. Shared cleanup disposes subscriptions first; a thrown disposer can prevent kill/settlement. Windows kill and POSIX kill/destroy differ. Codex child termination closes stdin, uses TERM or Windows tree helper, drains up to five seconds then waits one second; final exit-wait result is not a guarantee of exit. Preserve live/unverifiable/exited, not kill-request=exited.

PTY-created CLI authentication/refresh, native PTY behavior and Windows process tree destruction are externally owned CLI/native execution boundaries; this contract is its checked-in orchestration and parser, not provider/OS success.
futureAcceptance: Recorded synthetic current/prior CLI transcripts: reordered/model-scoped labels, malformed/decimal/huge percentage, ANSI/OSC, partial windows, repeated reset labels, zero/overflow durations, DST/date rollover and timezone variants.

Fake event scheduler for timeout/exit/auth/late data/write/disposer throw; prove no second settlement and characterize possible leaked child. Later disposable per-OS PTY and WSL/profile fixtures with no real auth; assert actual descendant exit independently.
Characterize trust-prompt automatic answer and separately gate intended no-unrequested-config-effect behavior.

Last waiter abandonment can discard a queued operation; an already-running UNC operation retains its slot until native completion. Non-WSL paths bypass the queue. No credential bytes were read in this audit.

Launch materialization is a separate pending owner join, not filled from these received paths.

Host/home lock contention and abort while queued, RPC auth versus transport failure with fallback on/off, WSL backend failure routes, no real user process or account. Test late underlying operations independently from returned error.

contracts.title: Codex RPC/backend windows, reset credits and partial results
resultContract: RPC init timeout30s (WSL40s), rate-limit read10s (WSL25s). JSON-line input buffer is unbounded; stderr tail100000 characters. Classification accepts finite numeric usedPercent, recognizes300/10080-minute windows within one minute and picks first matching known type; unknown-duration primary/session and secondary/weekly are positional fallback only when type unclaimed. Missing windows null. RPC mapper uses canonical window duration; backend maps positive finite seconds with ceil to actual minutes. Percent clamped; backend requires string plan_type (empty accepted) and otherwise returns null. Non-ok backend cancels unread response body then null.

Backend ten-second signal includes auth read; bearer built from current file for each call. RPC and backend data can come from different credential reads. Metadata supplement fills missing session when weekly exists, may replace weekly/plan/update time, and preserves primary result if supplementary fetch throws; credit-only augmentation may occur without adding session.

Credit count finite number is floored and clamped nonnegative. Backend can infer count from available rows if explicit count invalid; RPC requires numeric count. Zero count is treated complete even absent expiry. Missing credits omitted; explicit null retained where mapped. Status lowercased without trim, default unknown; wrong types/nonarray/null entries can throw. Timestamp numeric/numeric-string <1e10 treated seconds, otherwise milliseconds, or parsed date string; negative/past allowed. Earliest available expiry may already be past.

Reset credit consumption validates idempotency key by trimmed nonemptiness but sends original, uses30-second signal including auth read and no caller abort or local retry. Maps reset/nothingToReset/noCredit/alreadyRedeemed; unknown outcome rejects. Non-ok cancels unread body. Provider may already have mutated before parse/timeout rejection; remote idempotency/rollback is not established locally.

RPC error.message and several exception paths retain provider/CLI text; generic close path excerpts then redactString/sanitizeAgentFailureDetail, while auth-pattern and normal error paths have different protection (PI-TRANSPORT). Aborted result differs from parse error and unavailable.

Extractor finds executable with which/where execFile without timeout, resolves links/fallback paths, walks at most nine parents and known global layouts, reads candidate JS bundle files in enumeration order, first matching client ID/secret constants wins. Reads have no byte cap and errors return null. Source discovery was read only; no bundle/profile/credential values were queried and no constants copied to this report.

Each token/project/quota request uses Electron net and its own10-second signal; there is no whole-flow deadline/caller abort. Missing client credentials/refresh failure yields error. Undefined/null/NaN weekly, mismatched period bounds, top monthly-only response, numeric-prefix monthly values, wrong config/tier, first-config metadata; assert monthly property absent versus explicit null where relevant.

contracts.title: MiniMax cookies, browser/manual transport and snapshot selection

Normalize Cookie prefix, semicolon pairs and quoted name:value syntax; first exact _token required. Model options array members trimmed (wrong type throws into outer network classification), string CSV or default general; selection follows exact case-sensitive priority, then lone valid snapshot fallback even if model differs. Truthy model string, remaining/start/end required; start is validated but not used for duration or ordering. Used=(100-remaining) rounded/clamped, fixed300-minute window, reset uses raw end_time units. Weekly null.

Missing matching snapshot=>usage-unavailable,401/403=>stale-token,other HTTP=>server. Success source web; no automatic provider retry.

Fixed nonpersistent Electron partition is shared across calls. Clear cookies then Promise.all sets, request, finally clear. One rejected cookie set can trigger cleanup while other sets still pending; concurrent calls can overwrite/clear one another. Session failure falls back to manual Cookie header using SAME15-second signal, but HTTP non-ok does not fall back. Cookie/proxy setup/cleanup are not bounded by that fetch signal; cleanup occurs before response JSON parsing.

Manual fallback forwards cookie to optional unvalidated endpoint; source exposure is conditional on who can supply option, not proven reachable externally here. No provider endpoint values or credentials copied. Redactor removes Cookie header line plus eight named cookie keys in recognized case-sensitive assignment/quoted forms; no exhaustive secret grammar. Version1 encrypted/plaintext envelope accepts permissive Base64; unknown kind throws. Explicit plaintext decodes even if encryption now available; encrypted requires safeStorage available/decrypt success. Legacy data tries decrypt and then printable-cookie heuristic; unavailable encryption permits heuristic plaintext otherwise fails. safeStorage/OS cryptography remains native execution obligation.

Reuse E4-F29 plus secure-file support: POSIX chmod failures and Windows best-effort ACL behavior, including ignored temporary sync ACL false before rename and optimistic async ACL cache, remain source defects/limitations. No assertion that every stored cookie is encrypted or private on every platform.

Null placeholders skipped in search for later data.

Error status returns null windows and raw error.message; cleanup error warn is raw. Existing test named never logs cookie only injects an error that does not contain cookie and checks result text; it is not proof that arbitrary provider/transport errors are scrubbed.

resultContract: Proxy normalize accepts nonstring as empty, trims/max2048, allowlists http/https/socks variants, keeps URL userinfo+host and drops path/query; bypass first4096 chars split/trim. First truthy environment key wins, even if whitespace/invalid and later key valid. Configured child proxy writes six variables and explicitly empty NO_PROXY to remove inherited bypass.
